strings.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flea needs camera access to take listing photos, capture live refund proof, and verify your ID.
strings.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flea needs microphone access to record live refund proof videos.
strings.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flea needs photo library access to attach images to your listings and profile.
strings.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Flea saves order receipts to your photo library.
strings.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Flea uses Face ID to keep your account secure.
